name: Dressmaker Simulator
summary:
Open the doors to a warm storybook atelier and turn every customer request into a finished garment. Accept a commission, choose the right material, sketch a design, arrange pattern pieces with the grain, cut the fabric, pin it to the mannequin, sew each seam, add decorations, and deliver your work.

Build a season from 12 garment projects, 16 fabrics, varied colors and patterns, and 10 client profiles with different tastes. Match fabrics and trims to each brief, balance cost against quality, earn money and reputation, keep favorite creations in the wardrobe, and care for Marmalade, the atelier cat.

Every production stage is designed for controller play, including precise pattern cutting. Keyboard and mouse are also supported. Versioned local autosave, Continue, pause, clear back actions, and a complete season flow make this a full cozy crafting game rather than a limited demo.
